{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ninth Aquatic Zone''' was a survival area on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thrantin]] used by the [[Galactic Outdoor Survival School/Legends|Galactic Outdoor Survival School]]. It was located in [[Territory C2]] and was the last zone traversed by the [[Twilight Class]] in their record-setting route.
